answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond and shows a unique attestation before any vote counts. A knoll of fake personas cannot share one bond; each new identity needs its own locked stake, so attacker cost grows linearly with every Sybil. The ledger treats any account caught double-signing as hollow and slashes its bond, so forged agents lose their standing. Even a flawless ivory forgery must pay full price per fake identity, making mass impersonation economically irrational.
